t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are two colour groups, one group always does better than the other. once the stake starts lowering i switch the colour group by figuring out which colour group is doing better.

vb_textbox.text: there will be two groups- red/pink/purple/brown and blue/green/yellow/orange. There will be pne group performing better once you find this out stick to that group until the score starts to decrease, this is when you will need to switch to the next colour group.
